definition_rule: Business is asserted by the source to be owned by a citizen/member of the named nation. The threshold may be explicit or unstated.
cedar_press_treatment: Store source text and ownership threshold separately.

definition_rule: Source permits descendants who are not necessarily enrolled citizens.
cedar_press_treatment: Distinct identity_scope value; never relabel as citizen-owned.

definition_rule: Source accepts members of other tribes or broad Indigenous ownership.
cedar_press_treatment: Store tribal affiliation and certifying source.

definition_rule: Government or tribal corporate enterprise, not an individual member-owned firm.
cedar_press_treatment: Separate ownership universe; join to NEED/USET rather than blend.

definition_rule: Business has been certified under a tribal preference regime, often with ownership/control and recertification requirements.
cedar_press_treatment: Preserve certification number, tier, start and expiration.

definition_rule: Directory includes local, chamber, tourism or non-Native businesses alongside member-owned firms.
cedar_press_treatment: Require record-level identity_basis; do not inherit page-level labels.

definition_rule: Artist-specific roster with citizenship or program eligibility.
cedar_press_treatment: Separate Cedar artist vertical or subtype.

definition_rule: Official CSV, TXT, XLSX or API export with stable keys and no authentication.
cedar_press_treatment: Automate first; weekly or monthly diff.

definition_rule: Stable public HTML/table/cards with straightforward pagination.
cedar_press_treatment: Automate with DOM parser and raw snapshots.

definition_rule: Structured PDF/DOCX or stable landing page with current document links.
cedar_press_treatment: Poll landing page, hash files and parse by edition.

definition_rule: Dynamic portal, protected page, image-only source or integrity concern.
cedar_press_treatment: Browser-assisted extraction or direct feed; stronger monitoring.

definition_rule: Intake-only, request-only, internal or historical list with no public records.
cedar_press_treatment: Partnership outreach; do not represent as scraped coverage.

definition_rule: Certification dates should fall within a plausible range and expiration should not precede certification.
cedar_press_treatment: Flag but retain raw source value.

definition_rule: A business may appear in multiple lists with different scopes or certification periods.
cedar_press_treatment: Use one source assertion per appearance; deduplicate only at the entity layer.

definition_rule: A page can remain public after certifications expire or programs go dormant.
cedar_press_treatment: Track source edition, first_seen, last_seen and current/expired status.

definition_rule: Directories often publish owner names, phones and emails.
cedar_press_treatment: Publish only public business contact data with source attribution; avoid inferring personal details.

definition_rule: Review robots.txt, site terms, rate limits and source contact preferences.
cedar_press_treatment: Use respectful polling and prefer official exports when available.

definition_rule: Business is associated with an Alaska Native corporation shareholder, descendant or spouse. This is a corporate shareholder relationship, not tribal citizenship.
cedar_press_treatment: Use a separate directory_type and relationship basis; never relabel as citizen/member-owned.

definition_rule: Dated notices may document an application, hearing, approval, denial, renewal or expiration rather than a current master roster.
cedar_press_treatment: Store each notice as an event and derive current status only from a complete event sequence.

definition_rule: Official tribal-government, TERO, Indian-preference, citizen/member-owned or tribe-maintained list with a reasonably direct identity assertion.
cedar_press_treatment: Highest evidentiary priority. Preserve as the controlling source assertion unless the tribe updates or withdraws it.

definition_rule: Tribal or tribe-linked directory that is mixed, editorial, self-submitted, historical or not a formal certification roster.
cedar_press_treatment: Retain high visibility, but preserve its limitation and do not upgrade identity beyond the source wording.

definition_rule: A tribal program, certification system, intake form or legally required roster is confirmed, but current records are not publicly downloadable.
cedar_press_treatment: Request a direct periodic export and do not represent the source as scraped coverage until records are received.

definition_rule: State, chamber, nonprofit, CDFI or regional directory that may identify Native businesses but is not the relevant tribe's own assertion.
cedar_press_treatment: Use for discovery, matching, affiliation leads and gap checks. Never overwrite a tribal-source assertion.

definition_rule: Business-license, contractor, local-commerce or similar source where inclusion does not imply Native ownership.
cedar_press_treatment: Generate candidates only. Ownership must be independently verified.

definition_rule: Reference identifying tribes, TERO offices, programs, contacts or documents rather than individual businesses.
cedar_press_treatment: Use to measure source coverage and generate research tasks, not business records.

definition_rule: Tribal Primary > Tribal Secondary > Tribal Partnership metadata > Cross-Reference > Discovery Only.
cedar_press_treatment: The entity matcher may propose links across levels, but source assertions remain separate and ranked.

definition_rule: Sources may disagree on ownership, affiliation, certification status, business name or whether a record remains active.
cedar_press_treatment: Retain parallel assertions, flag the conflict and resolve through the highest-authority current source rather than silently overwriting.
